parameter_rules: Use the exact structured parameter names exposed by the selected function schema.
Provide every required item name, count, position, or other argument explicitly; current state and prose never supply missing values.
Actor-owned action skills may use empty parameters only when their strict function schema accepts an empty object.
evidence_rules: Expected evidence describes what to inspect after execution; it does not prove success before runtime evidence exists.
Runtime evidence, not the card title or provider explanation, decides the observed outcome.
selection_rules: Choose by action_card_id and do not output hidden primitive or action-skill identifiers.
Current-state requirements are advisory selection checks and never executable arguments.

A direct primitive exposes one runtime operation; an overlapping actor-owned action skill remains separate only because it adds owned behavior, local verification, multiple operations, or bounded recovery.

guidance: Use empty parameters for bounded shared-chest inspection.
Choose itemName and count from current inventory plus relevant world-event or relationship evidence, and provide both explicitly.
Choose itemName from current inventory and the Minecraft Basic Guide; the runtime still validates it explicitly.
Provide targetPosition or anchor explicitly and choose it from known nearby block coordinates; the runtime never invents placement coordinates.
Placement evidence proves the local physical change only; compare it with the active goal before continuing.

action_cards.title: Observe
action_cards.description: Refresh live inventory, nearby blocks, actors, and memory-facing state.

action_cards.title: Move To
action_cards.description: Move to an explicit position or bounded scout waypoint.
current_state_requirements: choose movement only when it reaches a specific actionable target or enables a fresh observe after movement
expected_evidence: position_delta evidence only; the next turn must use the new position for world, inventory, container, chat, or relationship progress
likely_blockers: missing target position or scout direction/distance

action_cards.title: Collect Logs
action_cards.description: Gather reachable low log blocks; success requires inventory evidence.
current_state_requirements: check whether nearby loaded world evidence contains reachable log blocks

action_cards.title: Mine Block
action_cards.description: Mine an explicitly requested block when tool, reachability, and expected-drop evidence allow it.
current_state_requirements: check whether nearby loaded world evidence contains the requested block

action_cards.title: Craft Item
action_cards.description: Craft an inventory-grid recipe such as planks, sticks, or crafting_table when exact ingredients exist.
current_state_requirements: check whether inventory has ingredients for the requested inventory-grid recipe

action_cards.title: Craft With Table
action_cards.description: Craft a table-bound recipe such as wooden_pickaxe against a placed crafting table, placing a carried table locally when possible. Do not use for planks, sticks, or crafting_table.
current_state_requirements: check whether nearby loaded world evidence contains a reachable crafting_table block
check whether inventory has ingredients for the requested table-bound recipe

action_cards.title: Consume Item
action_cards.description: Consume an explicit edible inventory item and verify inventory or vitals changed.
current_state_requirements: check whether inventory has the requested edible item

action_cards.title: Equip Item
action_cards.description: Equip one exact inventory item in hand and verify held-item state; this prepares later physical actions but is not itself durable world progress.
current_state_requirements: check whether inventory has the exact requested itemName
held-item evidence may already satisfy the preparation step

action_cards.title: Place Block
action_cards.description: Place one explicit inventory block into an empty/replaceable target cell, or onto a named support surface, and verify the world block afterward.
current_state_requirements: check whether inventory has the requested block item
supply an explicit target cell or support-surface coordinate in function parameters
likely_blockers: missing target position or support surface position

action_cards.title: Build Pattern
action_cards.description: Run one bounded block-pattern executor only when current context makes building relevant.
current_state_requirements: check whether inventory has solid build material
supply an explicit build anchor or target coordinate in function parameters

action_cards.title: Inspect Chest
action_cards.description: Inspect a nearby shared chest and record container snapshot, reachability, or openability evidence without generated code.
current_state_requirements: check whether a shared chest is nearby

action_cards.title: Deposit Shared
action_cards.description: Deposit role-allowed useful inventory into shared storage.
current_state_requirements: check whether a shared chest is nearby
check whether inventory has the requested depositable item

action_cards.title: Withdraw Shared

item_flows: crafting_table item itself is an inventory-grid recipe; use craft_item or a crafting-table action skill, not craft_with_table
wooden_pickaxe needs planks, sticks, and reachable placed crafting_table
station_requirements: inventory 2x2 can craft planks, sticks, and crafting_table
table-sized recipes require a reachable crafting_table world block
inventory station items are not usable stations until placed
blocker_recovery_guides: missing prerequisite should pivot to the nearest executable prerequisite action
occupied placement target should pick another explicit adjacent valid cell
repeated exact blocker should repair parameters or choose a different action
observe_stop_guides: do not repeat observe when the same scan and inventory already explain the blocker
observe is useful when it can reveal new reachable evidence or after movement
